mapper.select: insert into charging_station ( external_station_id , station_name , address , latitude , longitude , location , operator_name , station_status , source_type , use_time , detail_location , contact_phone , parking_free , is_deleted , updated_at ) values ( #{item.externalStationId} , #{item.stationName} , #{item.address} , #{item.latitude} , #{item.longitude} , ST_SetSRID( ST_MakePoint( #{item.longitude}::double precision, #{item.latitude}::double precision ), 4326 )::geography , #{item.operatorName} , '운영중' , 'PUBLIC_API' , #{item.useTime} , #{item.detailLocation} , null , null , false , current_timestamp ) on conflict (external_station_id) do update set station_name = excluded.station_name , address = excluded.address , latitude = excluded.latitude , longitude = excluded.longitude , location = excluded.location , operator_name = excluded.operator_name , station_status = '운영중' , source_type = 'PUBLIC_API' , use_time = excluded.use_time , detail_location = excluded.detail_location , is_deleted = false , updated_at = current_timestamp returning station_id
mapper.insert: insert into charger ( station_id , external_charger_id , charger_name , charger_type , connector_type , charging_speed_kw , price_per_kwh , status , charger_code , last_status_checked_at , is_deleted , updated_at ) values ( #{stationId} , #{item.externalChargerId} , concat('충전기 ', split_part(#{item.externalChargerId}, '-', 2)) , case when #{item.chargingSpeedKw} >= 100 then '초급속' when #{item.chargingSpeedKw} >= 50 then '급속' else '완속' end , #{item.connectorType} , #{item.chargingSpeedKw} , 347.20 , '사용가능' , split_part(#{item.externalChargerId}, '-', 2) , current_timestamp , false , current_timestamp ) on conflict (external_charger_id) do update set station_id = excluded.station_id , charger_name = excluded.charger_name , charger_type = excluded.charger_type , connector_type = excluded.connector_type , charging_speed_kw = excluded.charging_speed_kw , charger_code = excluded.charger_code , last_status_checked_at = current_timestamp , is_deleted = false , updated_at = current_timestamp
mapper.select: select count(*) from charger where station_id = #{stationId} and coalesce(is_deleted, false) = false
mapper.insert: insert into charger ( station_id , external_charger_id , charger_name , charger_type , connector_type , charging_speed_kw , price_per_kwh , status , charger_code , last_status_checked_at , is_deleted , created_at , updated_at ) values ( #{stationId} , #{externalChargerId} , #{chargerName} , #{chargerType} , #{connectorType} , #{chargingSpeedKw} , #{pricePerKwh} , '사용가능' , #{chargerCode} , current_timestamp , false , current_timestamp , current_timestamp ) on conflict (external_charger_id) do update set station_id = excluded.station_id , charger_name = excluded.charger_name , charger_type = excluded.charger_type , connector_type = excluded.connector_type , charging_speed_kw = excluded.charging_speed_kw , price_per_kwh = excluded.price_per_kwh , status = case when charger.status = '고장' then charger.status else excluded.status end , charger_code = excluded.charger_code , last_status_checked_at = current_timestamp , is_deleted = false , updated_at = current_timestamp
mapper.select: select s.station_id as stationId , coalesce(s.external_station_id, concat('PUBLIC-STATION-', s.station_id)) as externalStationId , coalesce(rep.connector_type, 'DC콤보') as connectorType , coalesce(rep.charging_speed_kw, 50) as chargingSpeedKw , count(c.charger_id)::int as activeChargerCount from charging_station s left join charger c on c.station_id = s.station_id and coalesce(c.is_deleted, false) = false left join lateral ( select cx.connector_type , cx.charging_speed_kw from charger cx where cx.station_id = s.station_id and coalesce(cx.is_deleted, false) = false order by case when cx.external_charger_id like 'AUGMENT-%' then 1 else 0 end , cx.charger_id asc limit 1 ) rep on true where coalesce(s.source_type, '') = 'PUBLIC_API' and coalesce(s.is_deleted, false) = false group by s.station_id , s.external_station_id , rep.connector_type , rep.charging_speed_kw order by s.station_id asc
